title: chased by black goo+portals
content: So the other day I posted about running in groups with people and it’s still consistent to this day. But last night I had the most intense dream I’ve had in a while that I can psychologically remember. Me and my friends were trying to get back to the classroom after doing a bunch of these “missions” and once we got on the floor everything in the room turned white and this black venom like goo was everywhere. It had a mind of its own and was very violent. I just remember being like “just make it back to the classroom”. She we booked it and to get back there was this pink/purple swirling portal just in the middle of this white ass wall. This isn’t the first time I’ve used portals in my dream, but it was just so crazy how comfortable I am with them like I really be jumping into portals in my dream??? This one wasn’t big, about a little bigger than a basketball. I stick my arms in the portal, about elbows deep and wait about 2 seconds before traveling. Idk has anyone else encountered the black goo or even portals?
